summary: Liquidity Services Inc. filed an 8-K on July 6, 2026, announcing the retirement of Chief Human Resources Officer Novelette Murray and the immediate appointment of Karen Fascenda as her successor. Fascenda, formerly Chief People Officer at Udemy, brings over 20 years of experience. The changes were effective July 6, 2026. No other deal terms, premiums, or advisor involvement were disclosed. This is a routine executive succession, not a forced departure. What to watch: any further leadership shifts or impact on HR strategy.
